annotation:
I was born and raised in a small town, where I developed a deep appreciation for nature and the beauty it holds. As a child, I spent countless hours exploring the woods near my home, discovering new plants and animals, and learning about the world around me. My parents, both educators, instilled in me a love of learning and a strong work ethic that has stayed with me throughout my life.

After high school, I attended a local college, where I pursued a degree in environmental science. During my time in college, I became involved in various environmental organizations and volunteered my time to help protect and preserve the natural world. I also had the opportunity to study abroad in Costa Rica, where I learned about tropical rainforests and their incredible biodiversity. This experience solidified my desire to work in the field of conservation and inspired me to continue my education.

Upon graduation, I moved to a large city to attend graduate school, where I studied urban ecology and sustainability. While in school, I worked part-time at a local nonprofit organization, where I helped design and implement green infrastructure projects in underserved communities. This work taught me the importance of equity and inclusivity in environmental efforts and showed me how I could use my skills to make a positive impact on both the environment and the people who live in it.

After earning my master's degree, I began working for a national conservation organization, where I currently serve as a project manager. In my role, I oversee the planning and implementation of habitat restoration projects across the country, working closely with local partners to ensure that our efforts benefit both wildlife and people. I am proud to be part of an organization that values collaboration, innovation, and the pursuit of knowledge, and I am grateful for the opportunities I have had to grow both personally and professionally.

Outside of my career, I enjoy spending time with my family and friends, traveling to new places, and staying active through hiking, cycling, and yoga. I am also passionate about literature and spend much of my free time reading and writing. I believe that stories have the power to connect us, to challenge us, and to inspire us, and I strive to create meaningful connections through the words I share.

As I reflect on my journey so far, I am reminded of the many people who have supported and encouraged me along the way. From my parents and teachers, to my mentors and colleagues, I am grateful for the wisdom and guidance they have provided, and I hope to pay it forward by supporting and encouraging others in their own journeys. I am excited to see what the future holds and am committed to using my talents and resources to create a more sustainable, equitable, and beautiful world for all.
